text:
marie: Heads-up: I'm going to start a 'split + rename' wave across the docs tree tonight (non-peak window 02:00 PT). It'll be several PRs rather than one monolith. Need quick alignment on reviewers and sequence.
ollo: Thanks for the heads-up. Can we land redirects first? If we move pages then update internal links later we'll cause a bunch of CI errors and missing anchors in live previews.
ben: I ran a dry run locally and link-checker complains about renamed headings (anchors). Example: `Broken anchor: #streaming-responses` from docs/api/streams.md after renaming the file. We should add redirects and update any hard-coded anchors in SDK snippets.
tia: I'll own staging preview validation. Suggest we stack PRs as 'redirects only' -> 'content moves (no content changes)' -> 'snippet updates & link fixes'. I can run the preview after each merge and post the preview URL.
luca: For reviewers, can we tag: docs-core on the redirects PR, api-owners on the move PR, and SDK on the snippets PR? Keeps review scope small.
marie: Agreed. Plan I'm about to open: PR 5310_redirects, PR 5311_moves, PR 5312_snippets. Merge window 02:00-04:00 PT. I'll apply do-not-merge until checks pass.
docs-bot: docs-ci: PR 5311 failed anchor-check step. See: https://ci.internal/builds/99122. Failure excerpt: `ERROR: anchor-checker found 7 broken anchors`
anita: Small request: add a short 'migration map' file in PR 5310 with pairs old->new paths. That helps support search and can be used by the redirects plugin and Netlify `_redirects`.
ben: Also watch for non-markdown links in contrib files and examples (README.md, CODE_SAMPLES). My grep found a few absolute links to `/docs/reference/old-endpoint` in examples repo. Might need backpatch or a redirect.
tia: During preview I'll run these checks (will paste results): 1) nav and top-level sidebar loads 2) sample page render for 10 moved pages 3) anchor clicks in TOC (spot-check) 4) search returns moved pages 5) link-checker shows zero broken anchors 6) verify examples compile in the preview site
luca: If preview proves flaky, we have a fallback: land redirects, revert moves, then incrementally re-land moves in smaller batches. Not ideal but safer for 3rd-party link stability.
marie: I'll include a README snippet in each PR describing the intended order + rollback steps. Also to minimize churn, I'll group related files into logical bundles (apis, tutorials, guides) instead of random per-file moves.
docs-bot: NOTE: The redirects plugin supports both plugin-based rules and a `_redirects` file. Consistency recommended.
anita: One more ops note: support team will get a short notice with the mapping and preview link mid-day — they can temporarily enable enhanced logging if we see customer reports after the rollout.
ben: Tagging infra: if anchor-checker is rate-limiting on the CI side we might get spurious failures. We can rerun the job a couple times before rolling back.
tia: I'll post the first preview URL here once PR 5310 is merged. If anything looks off I'll open a small hotfix PR to add redirects for missing pages.
marie: Thanks everyone. Opening PRs now and tagging reviewers. Will update this thread with links and ETA for the merge window.
